title: Three Card Rummy

hintReason.lowEnoughToPlay: Under the dealer's qualifying limit of 20 — play
hintReason.weakHand: 20 or more leaves little to play for — fold

betGuide: Set the ante and any low bonus, then bet
scoringNote: The three cards total as low as possible; 0 is best. Face cards are 10, an ace is 1. Three of a rank, or three in suit and sequence, count 0.
qualifyNote: The dealer qualifies on a total of 20 or less.

tutorial.betControls: Set the ante and an optional low bonus, then press Bet.
tutorial.actionButtons: Play to match the ante, or fold to give up the ante.
tutorial.results: Check the result and the payouts.
